system.flavor:
When the punch misses, the trap snaps shut on nothing, or the tossed bottle shatters on the wall, use the moment: get one shaken friend moving toward the spot you called and put their nerve back.

Not enough to steady more than one person.

body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units of you and 1 unit of your rally point.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An enemy Action misses that creature. Response (unopposed): Make it Rallied until the start of your next turn; it may move 1 unit toward the rally point.

surges.html: Suppress one ordinary morale-based Success Die penalty on the target until the start of your next turn.
